snippet.title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 | Thank You Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Rejoin the Expedition on another journey through the whimsical hideout of a young Verso. 
In a land crafted through joy and innocence, sometimes darkness is uncovered when imagination gets carried away. 

—

To celebrate an incredible year, and as a sincere ‘Thank You’ to the community, the free ‘Thank You Update’ is available now. 
Our gratitude for this community goes far beyond what we are able to express, but this update should hopefully serve as our way of saying thank you.

Tomorrow comes, in Verso’s Drafts.
https://www.expedition33.com/linkhub
